body: The United States Virgin Islands are a US overseas territory and count as the US for country streak purposes.
Street View coverage features a large, visible red or white car.
The architecture is a unique blend of European styles, often featuring facades with large arches, central plazas, and courtyards.
Licence plates are short with either a bright blue or dark blue design.
The southern island of St. Croix has a loose grid pattern for its primary roads, while the northern islands of St. John and St. Thomas have much curvier roads.
A red truck with a red cab is the most common car and is only found on the southern island of St. Croix.
A less common white car without an antenna can also be found on St. Croix.
A white car with an antenna and a shorter cab is exclusively seen on the northern islands of St. Thomas and St. John.
Two boat trekkers are on the north coast of St. Croix, identifiable by blue waters and hilly islands. The camera has a distinct pink tint near Buck Island National Park.
